stories.title: Series Preview — Cubs at Cincinnati Reds, Game 1 of 3

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: Dansby Swanson Officially Activated From IL

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
9 games left, and now Dansby Swanson is in the lineup.

Activated off the IL today after a Grade 2 oblique strain — sidelined since August 16.

A two-time Gold Glove shortstop returning for a Wild Card run. October just got deeper.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB

stories.title: PCA 40-40 Watch — 44 HR / 37 SB, Three Steals Away

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
44 home runs. 37 stolen bases.

Pete Crow-Armstrong needs 3 more steals to become the first Cub EVER with a 40-40 season — and just the 7th player in MLB history.

9 games left. Clock is ticking.

#Cubs #GoCubs #ChicagoCubs

research.facts:
PCA 40-40 Watch — 44 HR / 37 SB
**Type:** FOLLOW UP (continuing from Sept 17 story)
**Freshness:** Stats confirmed through Sept 16 game; off day Sept 17 (no change)
**Key Facts:**
- Pete Crow-Armstrong: 44 HR / 37 SB through Sept 16 (off day Sept 17)
- Needs exactly 3 more stolen bases for 40-40 season
- 9 regular season games remaining (including today's game at Reds)
- Would be first 40-40 season in Cubs franchise history
- Would be just the 7th 40-40 season in MLB history
- Other 40-40 players: Jose Canseco, Barry Bonds, Alex Rodriguez, Alfonso Soriano, Ryan Braun, Ronald Acuña Jr.
- HR #43 broke Billy Williams' Cubs franchise record for LH homers (set 1970)
- HR #44 came in the same game (Sept 16 vs Braves)
- Leading MLB in bWAR; frontrunner for NL MVP with Shohei Ohtani sidelined
- 29 of 37 expert voters had him as NL MVP choice entering week

stories.title: Smokies Eliminated — Rocket City Sweeps Series

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Tennessee Smokies season is done — Rocket City won Game 2 at Knoxville 13-3, sweeping the series.

Cubs' AA affiliate had a solid 2026 campaign. The Trash Pandas just had a better week.

On to October and whatever comes next for this system.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB
